Hook.Purpose: Mechanical evidence for `AX_RULE_CHANGE_REQUIRES_OPERATOR_CONFIRM`: does the rule have a real `fix`?
Hook.Command: npx eslint --rule '{"/":"error"}' --fix-dry-run --format json . | jq '.[] | select(.messages | length > 0) | {file: .filePath, fixed: (.output != null), messages: [.messages[] | {ruleId, fix: (.fix != null), suggestions: (.suggestions | length > 0)}]}'
Hook.Expected: For every reported message: `fix` truthy → autofix branch; `fix` null → motivated-non-autofix branch (must be paired with explanatory comment in config).
